decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The storage area/facilities hereby permitted shall be used only for storage ancillary to the retail use of the premises and for not other purpose (including any purpose in Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any order revoking or re-enacting that order).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the __flank__________ wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.
Condition : 6 - 6.The floor space in the extension hereby approved shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the main uses of the premises as a shop and shall not be used for any other purpose
Condition : 7 - The windows formed in the south elevation shall be obscure glazed, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of first floor  extension to rear of shop premises.
